feeds.title: Motoress
feeds.description: Motoress is the No. 1 Women's Motorcycling Magazine For Every Woman Motorcycle Rider. Our mission is to educate, inform and provide a reliable resource to learn while encouraging the activity of motorcycling. Get News, Rider Technique, Gear & Bike Reviews on Motoress.

feeds.title: Babes Ride Out Blog
feeds.description: As the percentage of lady riders has risen, women are finding their space within the motorcycling community and with each other. Babes Ride Out serves as a way for digital friends to become lifelong friends and gives attendees a chance to make a real connection with the brands who support them.

feeds.title: BikerKaz
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Biker Kaz. As a female biker I wanted to share my personal thoughts and riding experiences with you.

feeds.title: Carla King Blog
feeds.description: In this blog, Carla writes about her Motorcycle Misadventures, gears, wheels, and recommendations.

feeds.title: Women's Motorcycle Tours Blog
feeds.description: Women's Motorcycle Tours is a website by women, for women which offer a variety of motorcycle tours for women that suits every desire, riding style, and geographic interest.

feeds.title: GearChic Blog
feeds.description: GearChic.com is dedicated to providing real advice about real motorcycle gear for women. As a women's motorcycle gear enthusiast, they help you figure out what type of gear you need.

feeds.title: MotoLady
feeds.description: MotoLady is created to encourage aspiring women riders which makes it one of the few websites about women in the world of motorcycling. This blog covers various motorcycles oriented articles in industry news, art, motorcycle fashion, design, and marketing, etc. Get women in motorcycling, industry news, and talent features.

feeds.title: WCM 2020 Blog
feeds.description: The Women's Coalition of Motorcyclists is dedicated to creating and growing a diverse culture of respect through awareness, advocacy, and education while preserving a positive image of female motorcyclists and increasing the participation of females in all aspects of motorcycling.

feeds.title: Princess Scooterpie Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about a Motorcycle Diva who likes to moto wander & writes about it.
